mapper.update: UPDATE media_channel_account account SET usage_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.channel_id = account.channel_id AND assignment.account_id = account.account_id AND assignment.assignee_id != #{userId} AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, operator_id = ( SELECT assignment.assignee_id FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.channel_id = account.channel_id AND assignment.account_id = account.account_id AND assignment.assignee_id != #{userId} AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at, assignment.id LIMIT 1 ), operator_name = ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT assignment.assignee_name ORDER BY assignment.assignee_name SEPARATOR '、') FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.channel_id = account.channel_id AND assignment.account_id = account.account_id AND assignment.assignee_id != #{userId} AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ), assign_time = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.channel_id = account.channel_id AND assignment.account_id = account.account_id AND assignment.assignee_id != #{userId} AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN account.assign_time ELSE NULL END, updated_by = #{operatorId} WHERE account.deleted_at = 0 AND ( account.operator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.channel_id = account.channel_id AND assignment.account_id = account.account_id AND assignment.assignee_id = #{userId} AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) )

UPDATE ad_account_asset_assignment SET assignment_status = 'RELEASED', released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_by = #{operatorId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at = 0

UPDATE ad_account_asset asset SET asset.inventory_status = 'AVAILABLE', asset.updated_by = #{operatorId}, asset.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE asset.inventory_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND asset.deleted_at = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ad_account_asset_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.ad_account_asset_id = asset.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 )

UPDATE media_asset asset SET status = CASE WHEN asset.asset_type = 'PIXEL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_user_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.asset_id = asset.id AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN 'ASSIGNED' WHEN asset.asset_type = 'AD_ACCOUNT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.account_id = asset.asset_code AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN 'ASSIGNED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END, application_id = CASE WHEN asset.asset_type = 'PIXEL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_asset_user_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.asset_id = asset.id AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN asset.application_id WHEN asset.asset_type = 'AD_ACCOUNT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_channel_account_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.account_id = asset.asset_code AND assignment.deleted_at = 0 ) THEN asset.application_id ELSE NULL END, assignee_id = NULL, assignee_name = NULL, updated_by = #{operatorId} WHERE asset.assignee_id = #{userId} AND asset.status = 'ASSIGNED' AND asset.deleted_at = 0
